title: CollabSciReM: Aligning Language Models for Scientific Conversations via Science-Aware Reward Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.27901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as research collaborators for hypothesis refinement, methodological planning, and technical analysis across multi-turn interactions. In this setting, a useful assistant must be accurate, methodologically justified, logically consistent, and token-efficient. Current alignment approaches rarely achieve all of these together. Instruction-tuned models gain conversational quality through verbosity, and we show that science-agnostic general collaborative rewards compress responses at the expense of scientific rigor. We propose CollabSciReM, a goal-conditioned reward framework that decomposes the session-level reward into conversational quality, scientific rigor, and structural efficiency. We also introduce SciQuality, a pairwise evaluation of multi-turn research conversations grounded in 300 held-out scientific papers and scored on six dimensions: methodological soundness, justification, log

translated_title: CollabSciReM：通过科学感知的奖励分解来对齐语言模型以进行科学协作对话
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.27901v1，公告类型：交叉）：大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用作研究合作者，在多轮交互中协助假设完善、方法规划和技术分析。在这一场景下，一个有用的助手必须做到准确、方法论上有依据、逻辑一致且令牌高效。目前的对齐方法很少能同时兼顾所有这些要求。经指令微调的模型往往通过冗长的表达来换取对话质量，而我们研究表明，与科学无关的通用协作奖励则会以牺牲科学严谨性为代价来压缩回答篇幅。我们提出 CollabSciReM，一个目标条件化的奖励框架，将会话级奖励分解为对话质量、科学严谨性和结构效率三个部分。我们还引入了 SciQuality，这是一种针对多轮研究对话的成对评估方法，基于300篇保留的科学论文构建，并在六个维度上进行评分：方法可靠性、论证合理性、逻辑……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 CollabSciReM 框架，通过将会话级奖励分解为对话质量、科学严谨性和结构效率三个目标条件化组件来对齐语言模型，使其胜任多轮科学协作对话，并配套推出基于六个维度的 SciQuality 成对评估方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CollabSciReM, a goal-conditioned reward framework that decomposes session-level rewards into conversational quality, scientific rigor, and structural efficiency to align LLMs for multi-turn scientific collaboration, along with SciQuality, a six-dimension pairwise evaluation method.
